limitations: The rule matches every Redirect call, including constant targets; a fixed-target redirect on this line would be a false positive.

purpose: A controller returns a redirect to a caller-supplied returnUrl (CWE-601 shape).

groundTruth.rationale: Redirect() receives the returnUrl request parameter directly, so an attacker can send the user to an external site after login.
